_references: Tikhonov & Arsenin (1977) Solution of Ill-Posed Problems
Backus & Gilbert (1968) Geophys J R Astr Soc 16:169-205

_provenance.data_origin: Gaussian spectral peak with Laplace-transform kernel, noise added to correlator
_provenance.real_data_accession: N/A (analytical Gaussian spectral peak with synthetic noise)

_description: Spectral function reconstruction from noisy Euclidean correlator via Tikhonov regularization. Validates kernel construction, forward model, Cholesky solver, peak recovery, and regularization parameter scan.
_groundspring_question: Can Tikhonov regularization recover the location and shape of a spectral peak from a noisy integral transform?

analytical_predictions.tikhonov_formula: rho = (K^T K + lambda I)^{-1} K^T G

expected_results.regularization_tradeoff_ratio_min_ration: Both under- and over-regularized RMSE must be at least 0.5x optimal RMSE, confirming a genuine trade-off.
